git_note: Editable torch-neuronx source directory is not a Git checkout; individual installed source files are hashed.

source_files.finding: _compute_attention_backward_nki passes query dtype into wrapped flash_attn_bwd with mixed_precision=True; the global HLO matmult flag does not change opaque NKI internals.
kernel_dtype follows q_ref.dtype; mixed_dtype is float32 when mixed_precision is enabled. BF16 Q/K/V can therefore select BF16 matrix operands while keeping FP32 statistics.

precision_counting: Regular MATMUL only; adjusted_flops/raw_flops=4 identifies FP32 per installed schema. Sum raw_flops; do not add overlapping engine durations. Counts cover both physical cores of the recorded rank0 logical core.
hypotheses_not_results: Cast Q/K/V at SDPA only; keep all other normalized activations and FP32 residuals unchanged.
Cast RMSNorm outputs to BF16 with explicit FP32 statistics and epsilon; retain FP32 residuals and enable existing Linear BF16 cache.
caveats: Profile is from the earlier zero-QK-shift-on dense graph. It is attribution, not accepted throughput.
Missing DMA notifications and HLO statistics remain; these precision counts do not establish a bandwidth bound.
Both proposed policies change arithmetic and need native gates, full-budget BPB and standalone checkpoint validation.
